answer: Each agent must register a unique device fingerprint and post a bond; creating N fake identities costs N bonds plus N distinct attested devices, which is economically prohibitive. One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted reputation slot anchored to a scarce external resource, such as verified hardware attestation. Like a vine drawing nectar from soil, the system extracts real cost from every new identity, and the pigment of reputation accumulates only through sustained honest work. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
